note: Each source is a 1536x1024 triptych — front | back | side, split by thin white rules — of the same model, wardrobe and backdrop, so only the hair changes between styles. `style` is the library id the three panels fill; null holds a sheet back until someone decides which entry it shows. A wrong photograph beside a method is worse than a placeholder: someone follows the steps expecting the picture. `framed: true` marks a sheet whose panels are already 4:5 portraits; it is cut at the rules as it is, with no reframing.

1.png.match: High rope-packed donut with gelled edges, nothing else on the head.

2.png.match: Front/back split with two plaited lines running up into a full afro bun.

3.png.match: Packed straight up with a puff over the top. The headband is incidental; the sheet's own captions are cropped away.

Flat Twist Front Afro.png.match: Held back: auburn hair; replaced by the black sheet below.

Sleek Low Puff Hairstyle Triptych.png.match: Gelled and brushed flat section by section, packed low at the back.

Chunky Twists_ Front, Back and Side View.match: Four sections from a cross parting. Assigned by the owner; the picture shows the sections hanging as braids with cuffs rather than woven out into a ponytail.

Three-View Braided Puff Hairstyle Refere.match: One cornrow a side gathered at the back. Assigned by the owner; the picture ends in a puff where the write-up says a tight bun.
